source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Sets AU Vetta's base reward rate from AU's own product page. It shipped at 0.0, so a Rs.2,999 card told users it earned nothing on every merchant with no specific rule, and the recommendation engine scored it last. AU publishes 2 Reward Points per Rs.100 on other merchant categories; at AU's own stated Rs.0.25 per point that is 0.50%. Also caps the utility rule at Rs.25 per transaction, per AU's footnote of 100 Reward Points per transaction.
